branding_plans.essential_tagline: Basic identity to launch with confidence.
branding_plans.corporate_tagline: A complete and strategic visual universe.
essential_features: 1 conceptual proposal + 1 round of minor adjustments (color or typography).
Corporate color palette with all necessary technical codes.
Primary and secondary typeface selection for communication consistency.
Basic Usage Guide (PDF) with essential guidelines to apply your logo correctly, allowed backgrounds, and usage errors to avoid.
corporate_features: 2 conceptual proposals + 2 complete revision rounds on the selected option.
Main version + adaptive variants (horizontal, vertical, and isotype for avatars).
Detailed color palette and corporate font system.
Custom support graphic elements such as patterns, textures, or custom iconography to enrich your brand.
Complete Visual Identity Manual defining the art direction, visual communication tone, logo construction grids and technical restriction areas.
Design of 3 to 4 applications chosen according to business needs.
global_features: 3 conceptual proposals + 3 exhaustive rounds of detailed revisions.
Main version + adaptive variants (horizontal, vertical, and isotype for avatars).
Detailed color palette and corporate font system.
Custom support graphic elements such as patterns, textures, or custom iconography.
Complete Visual Identity Manual with art direction, visual communication tone, logo construction grids and restriction areas.
Structured sub-brand system design to define with visual coherence how different business units or lines relate to each other.
Suite of up to 10 advanced corporate applications to choose from.
branding_plans.essential_target: Ideal for: Entrepreneurs and small local projects that need professional visual foundations without unnecessary complexity.
branding_plans.corporate_target: Ideal for: SMEs and brands that want to position strongly, differentiate from competitors, and expand their reach.
branding_plans.global_target: Ideal for: Consolidated companies, corporations, or umbrella brands managing multiple subdivisions, independent products, or complex initiatives.
